<translate>
'''Meditation''' is a passive skill that speeds up your Ki and stamina regeneration and gives you a chance to automatically dodge melee attacks. Against players the dodge depends on how much faster you are than the attacker; against other enemies, on how much higher your Battle Power is.
</translate>

<translate>
== Learning it ==

[[Special:MyLanguage/Master Roshi|Master Roshi]] (Good alignment), [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]] (no alignment requirement) and [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza|Frieza]] (Evil alignment) teach Meditation. Level 1 costs 300 TP and each level costs 300 TP more, up to 3,000 TP for level 10.
</translate>

<translate>
== Regeneration ==

Each level gives '''+5% Ki and stamina regeneration''' (+50% at level 10). It works passively, all the time. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Stats and Attributes|Stats and Attributes]] for how regeneration works.
</translate>

<translate>
== Passive dodge ==

With Meditation you can automatically dodge '''basic melee attacks''':

* '''Against players''' you need to be faster than the attacker. Speed comes from your Resistance (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Stats and Attributes|Stats and Attributes]]).
* '''Against other enemies''' you need a higher Battle Power than the attacker.

Once you just meet the requirement you have a small chance to dodge, and the chance grows the bigger your advantage is, up to a maximum. Each level of Meditation lowers the advantage you need and raises the maximum chance.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! !! <translate>Against players</translate> !! <translate>Against other enemies</translate>
|-
! <translate>Advantage needed at level 1</translate>
| <translate>2.5 times faster</translate> || <translate>2 times the Battle Power</translate>
|-
! <translate>Advantage needed at level 10</translate>
| <translate>1.4 times faster</translate> || <translate>The same Battle Power</translate>
|-
! <translate>Chance when you just meet the requirement</translate>
| 10% || 10%
|-
! <translate>Maximum chance at level 1</translate>
| 21% || 30%
|-
! <translate>Maximum chance at level 10</translate>
| 35% || 50%
|}

<translate>
Every dodge has a price and a limit:

* A dodge costs '''3% of your max stamina'''.
* Consecutive dodges get less likely: each one multiplies the chance of the next by 0.75. The streak resets after 3 seconds without dodging.
* Two dodges are at least half a second apart.

These values are the server defaults.
</translate>
{{Config|Combat Config|speedDodge*}}

<translate>
== Notes ==

* The [[Special:MyLanguage/Glind|Glind]] racial passive '''Celestial Body''' makes the Meditation dodge 50% more likely.
* The Meditation dodge is separate from the '''perfect evasion''' you get by dashing at the right moment. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Combat|Combat]].
</translate>
